name: Ferryman
tagline: Every card in hand is a coin; every card on the Dock is a passenger.
core_loop: On your turn ferry a Dock passenger by paying an equal-or-higher (or buoyant) hand card onto the shared Toll pile, or spend the turn wading a toll card or drawing.
win_condition: Most points from ferried passengers, kin-fare bonuses and suit majorities, minus one per card left in hand.
